The camera is across the junction at waist height, eight paces off; the corner lamp light comes from the upper RIGHT. The corner gas lamp post stands in the foreground at the RIGHT third, its yellow light falling across them. The dark terrace wall with shuttered windows fills the LEFT edge. The camera tilts up from the man to the cobbles, across the whole shot as <Subject 1> tramples calmly over <Subject 2>'s body, his boots coming down on her pinafore, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 <Subject 2> writhes and screams on the wet cobbles, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:05 while he tramples calmly over <Subject 2>'s body. By 00:07 the camera is tilting up through the last frame, with <Subject 1> now in frame, and the action continues with it.
